words: The Lark sheet with the official app and site links for each brand. Only the ATL edits it. Every link you send is copied from here.
The download-button screenshot for each brand, kept in storage (R2). You send it; you never take your own.
Canned line [6]. Sent word for word on every chat under this SOP.
The tag for this case in contact_log.
Where every contact is logged with its time. No UID means no attribution.
The next level up. For a PIC, the ATL.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Use this SOP when the player
items: Cannot find us
The brand is missing on Google or any search engine, or he sends a screenshot of search results without it.
Cannot load
The site will not open or load.
Asks for the link
"the usual link", "link lama", "link apps" or similar.
Saw a look-alike
He reports a site that looked like ours but behaved wrongly.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: App first, site second, then UID
items: Point to the app
Confirm the problem. The app is the fastest way in. No guessing about the cause.
App link
One link, copied from the locked reference. Check the brand row first.
Screenshot
Straight after, as its own message: the stored brand asset.
Confirm download
Ask and wait. No reply after 3 minutes: prompt once, keep the chat open.
Site link as backup
One link from the locked reference. Tell him to save it; invite him to the official Telegram channel.
Trusted-source warning
Every chat, word for word.
UID and log
Ask for UID now, not earlier. Log in contact_log, tag Access Recovery.

tour.label: Scripts
tour.title: Canned lines, Bahasa Malaysia
items: Line 1
Baik bos. Cara paling cepat masuk adalah melalui app kami, dan app ini tak bergantung pada Google. Saya hantar link download sekarang.
Line 2 (swap in the brand)
Link download app SK69: [LOCKED APP URL]
Line 3
Lepas buka link tu, tekan butang download macam dalam gambar ni ya bos. [ATTACH LOCKED SCREENSHOT]
Line 4
Sudah berjaya download bos?
Line 5
Untuk backup, ini link website rasmi kami: [LOCKED SITE URL]. Simpan link ni dan join channel Telegram rasmi kami supaya bos sentiasa ada link terkini.
Line 6
Satu peringatan penting bos: guna link yang kami hantar di sini atau dari channel rasmi kami sahaja. Jangan guna link dari carian Google. Ada pihak buat website tiruan.
Line 7
Boleh bagi UID bos, saya nak record dalam account bos.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Eight hard stops
items: Say or imply the site cannot be listed, is blocked, or is being hidden.
Say "faham-faham lah" or anything that invites the player to read between the lines.
Name or send the fake domain to a player, even as a warning.
Put two URLs in one message.
Send any domain not on the locked reference sheet.
Ask for UID before the access problem is solved.
Close the chat without confirming the player got in.
Open a suspected fake site on a work device.

tour.label: Ladder
tour.title: Stuck? Five minutes, then go up
items: Verify
Understand the player's actual problem. PIC, first.
Check yourself
Handbook, SOP, locked reference, pinned posts. PIC, 5 minutes, firm. Tell the player you are checking.
Go to the upline
Screenshot plus what you already checked. PIC to ATL, immediately.
Management
ATL to Supervisor to Department Head, same shift. Automatic for money at risk, a site impersonating the brand, player data or credentials exposed, or the same issue hitting more than one player.

tour.label: Approver
tour.title: A player reports a look-alike site
tour.q: Has the player reported a site that looked like ours but behaved wrongly?
tour.yes: Ask for a screenshot only. Do not ask for the URL and do not open it. Escalate to the ATL the same shift with the screenshot.
tour.no: Carry on: app link, screenshot, site backup, warning, then UID.

pool.q: A player says he cannot find the brand on Google any more. What do you send first?
o: The app download link, as the fastest way in
The site and app links together
pool.why: App first, site second. The app removes the search dependency; the site link only solves today.

pool.q: The player asks why the site disappeared from Google. What do you say?
o: Do not explain or guess the cause; the app is the fastest way in
pool.why: Step 1 and Guards: never explain why it is missing, never imply it is blocked or hidden, never "faham-faham lah".

pool.q: To save time, can you send the app link and the site link in one message?
pool.why: Golden Rules: one link per message. Guards: never two URLs in one message.

pool.q: The locked reference is slow to open and you remember the app link. What do you do?
o: Wait and copy it from the locked reference
Ask a teammate to type it
pool.why: Never type a link from memory. Always copy it from the locked reference in Lark.

pool.q: You asked "Sudah berjaya download bos?" and 3 minutes pass with no reply. What now?
o: Prompt once and keep the chat open
pool.why: Step 4: no reply after 3 minutes, prompt once, do not close the chat.

pool.q: When do you ask for the player's UID?
pool.why: Fix the access, then capture the identity. Asking earlier is a guard breach.

pool.q: The player got in fast and is happy. Can you skip the trusted-source warning?
o: No: it goes on every chat, word for word
pool.why: Step 6: the trusted-source warning is mandatory on every chat under this SOP.

pool.q: A player says he used a site that looked like ours but his balance was wrong. What do you ask for?
o: The URL so you can check it
A screenshot only, then escalate to the ATL the same shift
Nothing, tell him to ignore it
pool.why: Step 8: screenshot only. Do not ask for the URL, do not open it. Escalate to the ATL the same shift.

pool.q: You have searched the Handbook and pinned posts for 5 minutes and found nothing. Next?
o: Go to the ATL now with a screenshot and what you checked; keep the player warm
pool.why: Escalation Ladder: the five-minute cap is firm. Still searching at five minutes is a step 3.

pool.q: Three players report the same access problem in one shift. What does the ladder say?
o: Step 4 triggers automatically: it goes to management the same shift
pool.why: Step 4 triggers automatically when the same issue hits more than one player.

pool.q: Access is fixed and you have the UID. Where do you log it?
pool.why: Step 7: log in contact_log with the tag Access Recovery. No UID means no attribution.

pool.q: You cannot find the download-button picture quickly. Can you screenshot the page yourself?
o: No: send the stored brand asset
pool.why: Step 3: use the stored brand asset. Do not screenshot it yourself.
